s: tri, (brUte iti । brU + SAnac .) vaktA । yaTA, -- “iti bruvARo maDuraM hitaYca tamAYjihanmETilayajYaBUmim । rAmaM muniH prItimanA maKAnte yaSAMsi rAjYAM nijiGfkzayizyan ॥” iti BawwiH । 2 । 40 ॥

m: ब्रुव mf(आ)n. calling one's self by a name without any real title to it
being merely nominally (ifc.; cf. क्षत्रिय-, द्विज-, ब्राह्मण-ब्रुव).
a: ब्रुव, ब्रुवाण — a. Professing or pretending to be, calling oneself by a name to which he has no real title (at the end of comp.), as in ब्राह्मणब्रुव, क्षत्रियब्रुव &c.

s: [t] tri, (bravItIti । brU + Satf .) kaTayan । vaktA । yaTA, -- “kfte niHsaMSaye pApe na BuYjItAnupasTitaH । BuYjAno vardDayet pApamasatyaM saMsadi bruvan ॥” iti prAyaScittatattvam ॥
